{
  "phoneNote": "The workshop photo gives a credible first impression, but the location arrives below the first screen and repeated contact sections make the page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero is clear and well illustrated, but the incomplete service grid, sparse towing section and repeated contact information weaken the overall design.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate the address, directions and opening hours into one contact section; remove the duplicate visit/hours block and redundant hero links, retaining the required phone action bar.",
    "Put the location beside the service headline on both viewports, and tighten the phone hero so the business, location and primary action are visible together.",
    "Use a balanced three-column service grid on desktop and incorporate towing coverage there, removing the separate sparse section with its isolated “Gorenjska” label."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the closing visit/opening-hours section repeats the address, directions, hours and access note already shown in the dark contact section."
  ]
}
